notes.contentHtml:
THE ARTICULATION AGREEMENT BELOW IS SUBJECT TO PERIODIC REVISION. PLEASE CONSULT A COUNSELOR EVERY SEMESTER TO OBTAIN CURRENT INFORMATION ABOUT POSSIBLE CHANGES IN THE AGREEMENT.


Admissions and Transfer Information


Academic Advising

It is recommended students meet with an advisor each semester.


Minimum Grade of C

All courses counted toward the major, including preparation for the major courses, must be completed with a letter grade of C (2.0) or better. Credit/No Credit grading is not accepted.


Language Proficiency Requirement

For some majors, students must meet a second-language proficiency requirement. This is satisfied with the first semester of an intermediate language or demonstrating proficiency in a language other than English. For details on how to satisfy this requirement, please refer to Language Proficiency Requirement.

notes.content: STUDENTS INTERESTED IN MAJORING IN HISTORY AND TEACHING AT THE SECONDARY LEVEL MAY ELECT THE SINGLE-SUBJECT OPTION IN HISTORY/SOCIAL SCIENCE. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION WILL ALLOW STUDENTS TO WAIVE THE CALIFORNIA SUBJECT EXAMINATION FOR TEACHERS (CSET) IN HISTORY/SOCIAL SCIENCE. FOR CERTIFICATION OF THIS OPTION, STUDENTS MUST MAINTAIN A 2.7 GPA BOTH IN OVERALL WORK AND IN COURSES USED TO COMPLETE THE MAJOR AND OPTION.
notes.contentHtml: STUDENTS INTERESTED IN MAJORING IN HISTORY AND TEACHING AT THE SECONDARY LEVEL MAY ELECT THE SINGLE-SUBJECT OPTION IN HISTORY/SOCIAL SCIENCE. SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION WILL ALLOW STUDENTS TO WAIVE THE CALIFORNIA SUBJECT EXAMINATION FOR TEACHERS (CSET) IN HISTORY/SOCIAL SCIENCE. FOR CERTIFICATION OF THIS OPTION, STUDENTS MUST MAINTAIN A 2.7 GPA BOTH IN OVERALL WORK AND IN COURSES USED TO COMPLETE THE MAJOR AND OPTION.
